description: Chat completion, deep tier (12k in, 2k out) — OpenAI-style chat completion served by the hub's provider router (strongest available model, up to 12000 input tokens and 2048 output tokens per call), with a signed receipt that binds the provider, model, token usage and the hashes of your messages and the reply. Supports optional strict json_schema output returned both parsed and as a string. Does not stream, call tools or functions, accept imag

max_tokens.description: Upper bound on the reply in tokens; defaults to 1024. A value above the tier cap is rejected with 400.

messages.description: Conversation, oldest first; the last message must have role user. At most 200000 characters in total. System messages are joined into the instructions.

model.description: Accepted and ignored: the hub routes by tier (the resource you paid for). Echoed as requested_model.

response_format.description: Either {"type":"text"} (default) or {"type":"json_schema","json_schema":{name,schema}}. The schema is always enforced strictly: root object, every property required, additionalProperties false, keywords limited to type, description, properties, required, additionalProperties, items, enum.

schema.description: Strict JSON Schema for the reply.

strict.description: Accepted for OpenAI compatibility; strict mode is always on.

name: chat-deep
